results_src: final.json:results,fit ; ff2_nominal.json / ff2_closdown.json / ff2_ew2p5.json / ff_uncal_fix.json:results,fit; mu95_asimov_smooth from zh_check/d2_cls.py

fake_photon_scan.note: photon scan x0.3 .. x3 of the corrected fake-photon rows (D36-style); stat+norm-free Eq.1 and Asimov (no sigma_b); a scan of non-prompt leptons is not applicable: the ZH Zll selection has no non-prompt-lepton row in b (config/sample_matrix_phase02.yaml:88,147: < 1e-2 events at 500 fb^-1, not simulated); the rate would have to be x100 higher to matter.

calibration.CMS_record: arXiv:2105.12780, JHEP 10 (2021) 174, doi:10.1007/JHEP10(2021)174, Table 2 (Zgg, eegg + mumugg)

fake_photon.classes_note: two-fake (Z+jets, tt-bar) classes: not in b (order of magnitude only, frozen reference: neglected); non-prompt leptons: not in b (<1e-2 events)

coupling.note: frozen ZH coupling method (BR fixed at SM = 'fixed'; 'resolved' = kappa_gamma(kW, kt=1) with sign on kW, i.e. the kW-sign convention) re-run on the corrected inputs (ff2_nominal.json:coupling). The mgg-template, kZ-sign-primary version is in zh_pyhf.json (qcurves).

cA.note: c_A re-derived with the corrected inputs (same method, observable m_llgg, Lambda = 1 TeV, profiled nuisances); signal rates unchanged (CP samples), only b changes. Intervals that differ from the frozen ones (complete list, generated): 1000|noclip|int95: [[-1.3, 1.3]] -> [[-1.2, 1.3]]; 1000|clip500|int68: [[-3.5, 3.5]] -> [[-3.5, 3.4]]

limitations: no Z gamma + 3 jets ME row (D43): the corrected fake component may be low; the frozen direct count (+5 % Z at most) is the upper variation
calibration reference mismatch (D39/D43): CMS inclusive in jets vs ZH >= 2 ME partons; kappa 0.5-1 moves Z by < 1 %
other-Higgs, Zgg, top and fake rows are not rescaled under coupling hypotheses
templates: pheff, lepeff, phscale, phres are assumptions (no Delphes scale factors), new relative to the frozen ZH study
per-bin MC errors of the continuum rows use err_bin = sqrt(nu e^2/y) (Poisson-equivalent)

cms_atlas_comparison.note: rows as in the frozen report (FINAL_report.md lines 595-596), WH/VBF-WH H->bb channels at their luminosities; not re-verified here (the WH executor owns the verified comparison)
